responses.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "Upwards of 1 point" means strictly more than 1 point (points > 1), using the season-to-date running total in driverStandings.points. Each driverStandings row is one entry, and rows with NULL wins are ignored (AVG skips them).

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 1 point" read inclusively, as at least 1 point (points >= 1).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 1 point" read as inclusive, meaning at least 1 point (points >= 1).
